# netbox_console_server_port_template (Data Source)

Retrieves a single console server port template from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_console_server_port_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "console_server_port_template_id" {
  value = data.netbox_console_server_port_template.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the console server port template.

### Optional

- `device_type_id` (Number) The ID of the device type associated with the console server port template.
- `module_type_id` (Number) The ID of the module type associated with the console server port template.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the console server port template was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the console server port template.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) The label of the console server port template.
- `last_updated` (String) When the console server port template was last changed.
- `type` (String) The type of the console server port template.
